verdict.rationale: Robotics safety patterns are a fair question for a robot framework, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no documented emergency-stop or safety-interlock pattern. Lifecycle nodes, QoS policies, action cancellation and real-time support are generic developer building blocks rather than documented safety patterns, so they earn no credit. The community remarks on safety-critical fit and e-stop incidents describe outcomes, not a platform-documented e-stop capability.
